# library-api

A REST API for a small library where members borrow books and librarians track loans with due dates.

> Generated by the Autonomous AI Software Engineering Platform (offline provider).
> Review the code before deploying it anywhere that matters.

Go 1.27 with the standard library only. Data is kept in memory, so run one
replica until a database replaces `store.go`. A record that belongs to another (a
`<parent>_id` field) must point at one that exists, lists can be filtered by it, and
deleting the parent deletes its children.

## Run and test

```bash
go run .             # http://localhost:8000
gofmt -l . && go vet ./... && go test ./...
```

## API

| Method | Path | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `GET` | `/healthz` | Liveness probe |
| `GET` | `/members` | List members |
| `POST` | `/members` | Create a member |
| `GET` | `/members/{member_id}` | Get one member |
| `PATCH` | `/members/{member_id}` | Update a member |
| `DELETE` | `/members/{member_id}` | Delete a member |
| `GET` | `/books` | List books |
| `POST` | `/books` | Create a book |
| `GET` | `/books/{book_id}` | Get one book |
| `PATCH` | `/books/{book_id}` | Update a book |
| `DELETE` | `/books/{book_id}` | Delete a book |
| `GET` | `/librarians` | List librarians |
| `POST` | `/librarians` | Create a librarian |
| `GET` | `/librarians/{librarian_id}` | Get one librarian |
| `PATCH` | `/librarians/{librarian_id}` | Update a librarian |
| `DELETE` | `/librarians/{librarian_id}` | Delete a librarian |
| `GET` | `/loans` | List loans |
| `POST` | `/loans` | Create a loan |
| `GET` | `/loans/{loan_id}` | Get one loan |
| `PATCH` | `/loans/{loan_id}` | Update a loan |
| `DELETE` | `/loans/{loan_id}` | Delete a loan |

# syntax=docker/dockerfile:1.7
FROM golang:1.27-bookworm AS build
WORKDIR /src
COPY go.mod ./
COPY *.go ./
RUN CGO_ENABLED=0 go build -trimpath -ldflags="-s -w" -o /out/app .

FROM gcr.io/distroless/static-debian12:nonroot
COPY --from=build /out/app /app
ENV PORT=8000
USER 65532
EXPOSE 8000
HEALTHCHECK --interval=30s --timeout=3s --start-period=5s --retries=3 \
  CMD ["/app", "-healthcheck"]
ENTRYPOINT ["/app"]

on:
  push:

  contents: read

jobs:
  test:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v7
      - uses: actions/setup-go@v7
        with:
          go-version-file: go.mod
      - name: Format
        run: test -z "$(gofmt -l .)"
      - name: Vet
        run: go vet ./...
      - name: Test
        run: go test ./...

  image:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    needs: test
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v7
      - uses: docker/setup-buildx-action@v4
      - name: Build image
        uses: docker/build-push-action@v7
        with:
          context: .
          push: false
          tags: library-api:${{ github.sha }}

apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: Deployment
metadata:
  name: library-api
  labels:
    app.kubernetes.io/name: library-api
spec:
  replicas: 1
  selector:
    matchLabels:
      app.kubernetes.io/name: library-api
  template:
    metadata:
      labels:
        app.kubernetes.io/name: library-api
    spec:
      securityContext:
        runAsNonRoot: true
        runAsUser: 10001
        seccompProfile:
          type: RuntimeDefault
      containers:
        - name: api
          image: library-api:latest
          imagePullPolicy: IfNotPresent
          ports:
            - name: http
              containerPort: 8000
          env:
            - name: DATABASE_URL
              valueFrom:
                secretKeyRef:
                  name: library-api-database
                  key: url
                  optional: true
          readinessProbe:
            httpGet:
              path: /healthz
              port: http
            periodSeconds: 10
          livenessProbe:
            httpGet:
              path: /healthz
              port: http
            initialDelaySeconds: 10
            periodSeconds: 20
          resources:
            requests:
              cpu: 100m
              memory: 128Mi
            limits:
              cpu: 500m
              memory: 256Mi
          securityContext:
            allowPrivilegeEscalation: false
            capabilities:
              drop: [ALL]
files.description: Deployment with probes, limits and a restricted security context

findings.message: Deleting a parent deletes its children (Member -> Loan, Book -> Loan): the foreign keys cascade.
findings.suggestion: Switch a relation to RESTRICT (or a soft delete) where its children must outlive the parent, such as records kept for audit.

findings.message: Data is kept in memory: it is lost on restart and not shared between replicas.
findings.suggestion: Put a database behind the store module before running more than one replica.

findings.message: The API is unauthenticated because the spec did not ask for auth.
findings.suggestion: Add OAuth2 or an authenticating gateway before exposing it publicly.
